notes.title: About Reversion games in MacOS
notes.content:
Mac users, we have an announcement about Reversion.

Since the latest version of macOS doesn't support old 32-bit apps, our games are now incompatible with MacOS. 😞 We won't support MacOS anymore in order to focus our support on current versions that have been successfully tested in numerous situations.

The alternative to play Reversion is to use Wine for Mac, a software that provides a compatibility layer capable of running Windows applications. We hope you can give an opportunity to our games this way!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/270570/Reversion__The_Escape_1st_Chapter/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/281060/Reversion__The_Meeting_2nd_Chapter/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/281080/Reversion__The_Return_Last_Chapter/

notes.title: The release date for the final chapter is here!
notes.content:
[h2]RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! 😱🥰
[/h2]

We're excited to announce that the conclusion to our narratively-driven aventure series Reversion will be [b][u]available on Steam February 28[/u][/b]!

🔗 Add the game to your Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/281080

[b]Reversion - The Return[/b] is the third and final chapter in the series which depicts a ruined Buenos Aires, in Argentina, in the year 2035. You will save your city by joining the Resistance against the villain Sergio.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34615135/811bd96b63079af2c2b9636c1c1afe91de27a633.jpg[/img]

For more information on Reversion visit the official site: http://3finteractive.net/#reversion

[b][u]A list of features include: 
[/u][/b][list]
[*] Story-based gameplay - thought-provoking story with many twists and turns.
[*] Challenging puzzles - use your wits to solve a wide variety of puzzles along your journey. 
[*] Gather clues - search the collapsed city for clues to your past and how the city came to be in ruins.
[*] Character interaction - talk with an array of charismatic and mysterious characters to find out more about your past and how to be a valuable member of the resistance.
[*] Fully voice acted - the cast of Reversion is brought to life by talented voice actors.
[*] Classic hand-drawn 2D graphics.
[*] Cinematic hand-drawn cutscenes, full of epic story moments. 
[*] Stylized soundtrack inspired by traditional Argentinian music.
[/list]
